Pre-expedition medical: history, examination, resting ECG, kidney function and electrolytes, HbA1c, lipid panel, urine albumin, TSH, ALT, blood count, and baseline blood lead, vitamin C and vitamin D; audiogram; tuberculosis blood test because of a past household contact. Guideline: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, hypertension and hyperlipidemia monographs (2026); Latent Tuberculosis Infection in Adults: Screening (2023) [S]

Wilderness and expedition medicine consultation to advise on fitness for the command, treatment for years away from care, nutrition and food safety, cold injury, and evacuation. Guideline: Wilderness Medical Society Clinical Practice Guidelines for the Prevention and Treatment of Frostbite: 2024 Update (2024); Wilderness Medical Society Clinical Practice Guidelines for the Out-of-Hospital Evaluation and Treatment of Accidental Hypothermia: 2019 Update (2019) [S]

Blood pressure: a validated upper-arm home monitor with a large cuff, two readings morning and evening for seven days, to confirm the diagnosis; less salt, less alcohol, more vegetables and daily walking from today. Guideline: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, hypertension and hyperlipidemia monographs (2026) [S]

Weight: his own goals for walking, hill work, portions and alcohol, discussed without blame; no weight-loss medicine before departure. Guideline: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025); Weight Loss to Prevent Obesity-Related Morbidity and Mortality in Adults: Behavioral Interventions (2018) [S]

Vaccinations, dental examination and treatment, and colorectal and other screening at the preventive visit before departure. Guideline: Medicare Preventive Services reference: visit templates, screening cascades, and documentation elements (2026); Adult Immunization Schedule by Age (2026) [S]

Hearing: audiogram, hearing protection around guns and engines, and seating so that his better ear faces the speaker. Guideline: CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, hypertension and hyperlipidemia monographs (2026) [S]
